description: This file defines the AppTheme class which provides static methods to generate light and dark themes for a Flutter application using Material 3 design. It specifies color schemes, app bar themes, input decoration themes, and bottom navigation bar themes.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: A utility class providing theme data for light and dark modes in a Flutter app.

methods.name: lightTheme
methods.description: Getter that returns the ThemeData configured for light mode.

methods.name: darkTheme
methods.description: Getter that returns the ThemeData configured for dark mode.
